title: 大林寺桃花
author: 白居易
intro: Down in the valley spring is over — but climbing a mountain, the poet finds peach trees just coming into bloom, and jokes that spring didn’t vanish after all: it simply moved uphill.
analysis: 农历四月，山下的花都已经谢了（“芳菲尽”），诗人登上庐山的大林寺，却意外看到桃花才刚刚盛开。山上气温低，花开得晚，这是一个自然现象；可诗人把它写得很有趣：我常常遗憾春天走了，找不到它去了哪里，原来它悄悄转到这山里来了。诗人把春天当成一个会走路、会躲藏的人来写，这种手法叫“拟人”。前两句是“人间”和“山寺”的对比，后两句从失望变成惊喜，感情有一个转折。这首诗短小活泼，读起来让人跟着高兴，也让人明白：换一个地方、换一个角度，失去的美好也许还能再找到。
analysisEn: In the fourth lunar month (around May), the flowers in the lowlands have all faded. Then the poet climbs Mount Lu to Dalin Temple and is surprised to find the peach trees only now in full bloom. The reason is simple — it is colder up high, so flowers open later — but the poet turns it into a small joke: “I was always sorry spring had gone and I couldn’t find where; I never guessed it had slipped up here.” He writes about spring as if it were a person who can walk away and hide; giving human actions to something non-human is called nǐrén (personification). The first two lines contrast “the human world” below with the mountain temple above; the last two swing from disappointment to delight. The poem is light and playful, and it leaves a gentle thought behind: go somewhere new, look from another angle, and a lost good thing may turn up again.
background: Bai Juyi (772–846) was demoted in 815 to a minor post in Jiangzhou (today’s Jiujiang), near Mount Lu. He wrote this in the spring of 817 after visiting Dalin Temple on the mountain with friends.
pronunciation: 盛开 shèng（不读 chéng）；芳菲 fāng fēi；觅 mì。
version: 采用统编语文教材文本，各版本基本无异文。原诗前有一篇小序，记录同游的人和山中景物，网站不收。

lines.py: rén jiān sì yuè fāng fēi jìn
lines.lit: In the human world, in the fourth month, the fragrant blossoms are finished;
lines.en: Down in the world, by the fourth month, every blossom is gone;

lines.py: shān sì táo huā shǐ shèng kāi
lines.lit: at the mountain temple, peach blossoms only begin to bloom fully.
lines.en: up at the mountain temple, the peach trees are just bursting into flower.

lines.py: cháng hèn chūn guī wú mì chù
lines.lit: Long I regretted spring returning with no place to seek it;
lines.en: I always grieved that spring went off and left no trace —

lines.py: bù zhī zhuǎn rù cǐ zhōng lái
lines.lit: I did not know it had turned and come in here.
lines.en: I never knew it had slipped away up here.

words.note: 庐山上的一座古寺，在今江西九江。
这里指山下平地，和高高的“山寺”相对；现代汉语“人间”指人世。
指农历，比公历晚一个月左右，已是初夏。
书面语，泛指花草；现代口语说“花”。
“恨”古义多指“遗憾”，比今天的“恨”（hate）轻得多。
书面语，现代汉语说“找”；“寻觅”还常用。

imagery.name: 桃花
imagery.zh: 山下花已谢尽，山上的桃花才盛开，是诗人“找回春天”的证据。
imagery.en: Peach trees blooming on the mountain after the lowland flowers have fallen — proof that the poet has “found spring again”.

imagery.name: 春
imagery.zh: 春天被写成一个会悄悄搬家的人，从山下转到了山上，可爱又有趣。
imagery.en: Spring is pictured as someone who quietly moves house, from the valley up to the mountain — playful and charming.
